title: Low-degree Fourier regularity
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $\epsilon,\delta\in\mathbb R$, and let $k\in\mathbb N$. Suppose every coordinate has stable influence at correlation parameter $1-\delta$ at most $\epsilon$, and $0\le\delta<1$. Then every nonempty set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with $|S|\le k$ satisfies $|\widehat f(S)|\le\sqrt{\epsilon/(1-\delta)^{\max(k-1,0)}}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
Every coordinate's stable influence at correlation parameter $1-\delta$ is at most $\epsilon$
